0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3) host the Utah Jazz (1-8) as of today, with Minnesota third in the Northwest, half a game back, sixth in the West, and riding a three-game winning streak, while Utah sits 14th in the West and is on a seven-game losing streak. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), Joan Beringer (fracture), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18.
